description: ADR-0555 hardening (FRIC-1781400000): the breadth bound. A single OWNERS file claiming more tracked paths than [owners] max_paths_per_owners_file (here 3) cannot bulk-neuter a tree's unowned accounting — only the first <bound> covered paths (path-sorted, deterministic) keep ownership, the excess stays UNOWNED, and the producer names the split-the-registration fix. Closes the breadth-unlimited weakness (PR #704 review, MED-2).
